description: This file defines a class 'DBHealthCheck' responsible for checking the health of database tables, particularly MySQL tables, by verifying their engine types and providing functions to update table engines to a recommended type.
external_files: db connection or database wrapper object (implied by usage of $db->databaseType, $db->databaseName, and $db->_Execute)

classes.name: DBHealthCheck
classes.description: A class to assess and manage the health of database tables, especially for MySQL, by checking table engine types and updating them to a recommended engine.

methods.name: DBHealthCheck
methods.description: Constructor that initializes database properties based on the provided database connection object.

methods.name: isMySQL
methods.description: Checks if the database type is MySQL.

methods.name: isOracle
methods.description: Checks if the database type is Oracle.

methods.name: isPostgres
methods.description: Checks if the database type is PostgreSQL.

methods.name: isDBHealthy
methods.description: Determines if the database is healthy by verifying if there are any unhealthy tables.

methods.name: getUnhealthyTablesList
methods.description: Returns a list of tables that are considered unhealthy based on their engine type or naming conventions.

methods.name: updateTableEngineType
methods.description: Updates the engine type of a specified table to the recommended engine (InnoDB) if the database is MySQL.

methods.name: updateAllTablesEngineType
methods.description: Updates the engine types for all tables identified as unhealthy in the database to the recommended engine type if the database is MySQL.

methods.name: _mysql_getUnhealthyTables
methods.description: Retrieves a list of tables that are not using InnoDB or are sequence tables, indicating they are unhealthy.

methods.name: _mysql_updateEngineType
methods.description: Executes an SQL command to alter a specific table's engine type to the recommended one.

methods.name: _mysql_updateEngineTypeForAllTables
methods.description: Updates all unhealthy tables to the recommended engine type.
